_readme: Week 10 bonus — the AgentCard this orchestrator (src/agent/orchestrator.py) would advertise if it were reachable over A2A instead of called in-process by eval/race_multiagent.py. Nothing here is served over a network in this exercise; this file is the card a real A2A deployment's /.well-known/agent.json would return, hand-written against the same shape.
name: motor-claims-triage-team
description: A manager plus two narrow specialists that triage a motor own-damage claim: decides PAYABLE, NOT_PAYABLE, or REFERRED, and the exact amount owed. Raced against a single hand-built ReAct agent on the same 10 claims — see race_table.md before assuming this is the one to keep.

provider.organization: Team JDC — AI Engineering League, Week 10 Task Set D

authentication._note: Not implemented in this exercise — src/mcp_servers/gateway_server.py's token scoping (Week 9 bonus) is the closest thing actually built to this; a real A2A deployment would put an equivalent scoped token here, not leave the team open.

skills.name: Triage a motor own-damage claim
skills.description: Given a claim_id, returns a coverage decision (PAYABLE/NOT_PAYABLE/REFERRED) and, if payable, the exact amount owed — with the facts-specialist summary and the coverage-specialist's cited exclusion clause attached as supporting detail.
examples: Is claim C-008 payable, and if so for how much?
